R656.note: Raw socket replaced by Jakarta Mail Transport/MimeMessage with strict InternetAddress parsing, CRLF cannot reach the wire; the whole-method rewrite and new dependency floor are stated plainly and the confirmation still reaches the customer.

R657.note: Null check on the lock() result with early return; live connections still get the message once, expired ones are skipped, and Notifier keeps its weak_ptr.

R658.note: Allowlisted column plus clause.OrderByColumn keeps sort off the SQL text, but the invented field_desc token grammar silently maps anything else (including the SQL-fragment form the original accepted, e.g. total_cents DESC) to id ASC instead of erroring, so a legitimate sort request can quietly return a differently ordered export.

R659.note: Roslyn removed and replaced with a fixed arithmetic grammar over Total/Tax returning a boxed decimal in the same Task<object?> shape; the grammar restriction is what the contract calls for and is stated.

R660.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and explicit UTF-8 at the reported sink; only other change is the null-coalesce that drops an undefined-index warning.

R661.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP on param before concatenation neutralizes filter metacharacters; filter structure, {0} substitution and response output are otherwise unchanged.

R662.note: Does not build: concatenating two interpolated strings with + yields string, not FormattableString (CS0029), so ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync is never reached; the parameterization design itself would preserve the contract, but the write-up claims a verification it cannot have run.

R663.note: Canonicalize-then-contain via toRealPath/startsWith closes traversal at any encoding depth, but deleting the second URLDecoder.decode drops the double-encoding older-client support the original comment explicitly provided (their filenames now 404) and the write-up calls it merely redundant rather than stating that regression.

R664.note: Extension allowlist plus UUID rename and containment closes dangerous-type and traversal, but the invented png/jpg/jpeg/gif/pdf allowlist rejects other legitimate uploads the original accepted, empty files are now rejected without being stated, and the stored name/return string change from the original filename to a UUID.

R665.note: preg_replace_callback removes the /e eval and the formatter allowlist stops arbitrary callables, but the documented contract is any formatting function name and unlisted legitimate formatters (nl2br, strrev, number_format) now silently fall back to strtoupper instead of failing visibly.
